# Pull Request template

## What
Describe the change in plain language.

## Why
Why is this change needed? What problem does it solve?

## Security considerations
- Has this been tested? Describe tests.
- Any new private key handling or operational risk?
- Suggested mitigations and recommended audit scope.

## How to test
Step-by-step instructions to reproduce locally.

## Checklist
- [ ] Tests pass
- [ ] Docs updated
- [ ] Security review requested
